rows.sourceEnglish: A soil cross-section shows dark topsoil above pale subsoil, with two worms. Beside it, a jar of soil settles into three layers — sand, silt and clay.
rows.currentTarget: Soil cross-section e bontsha dark topsoil ka hodima pale subsoil, e na le diboko tse pedi. Ka thoko, soil in a jar settles into three layers — sand, silt le clay.
rows.proposedTarget: Soil cross-section e bontsha dark topsoil ka hodima pale subsoil, e na le diboko tse pedi. Ka thoko, mobu o ka nkhong o lula ka mekhahlelo e meraro — sand, silt le clay.
rows.backTranslation: The soil section shows dark topsoil above pale subsoil and two worms. Beside it, soil in a jar stays/sits in three stages/layers — sand, silt and clay.
rows.reason: Bare lula does not explicitly carry particle sedimentation; mekhahlelo has not been independently established as physical sediment layers. Prior 955 repair deliberately retained layers. The exact settles into three layers clause preserves both physical process and category while localizing the jar framing.
rows.recommendedTarget: Soil cross-section e bontsha dark topsoil ka hodima pale subsoil, e na le diboko tse pedi. Ka thoko, mobu o ka nkhong o settles into three layers — sand, silt le clay.

rows.sourceEnglish: A compost heap cut open, showing alternating layers of dry brown material and fresh green material, heat rising from the middle, and an arrow showing it being turned.
rows.currentTarget: Heap ya compost cut open e bontsha alternating layers tsa dry brown material le fresh green material. Heat e nyoloha ho tswa bohareng; an arrow shows it being turned.
rows.proposedTarget: Heap ya compost e bontshwa e butswe hore bokahare bo bonahale. E bontsha mekhahlelo e fapanyetsanang ya dintho tse ommeng tse sootho le dintho tse foreshe tse tala. Mocheso o nyoloha ho tswa bohareng; motsu o bontsha hore qubu e a phetholwa.
rows.backTranslation: The compost heap is shown opened so its inside can be seen. It shows alternating stages/layers of dry brown things and fresh green things. Heat rises from the centre; the arrow shows that the heap is being turned.
rows.reason: Opening so the inside is visible does not explicitly preserve the source cut-open cross-section. Use exact cut open and layers; the dry/brown, fresh/green, alternating, heat-middle and turning-arrow descriptions are otherwise bounded and do not assert a guaranteed hot centre in practice.
rows.recommendedTarget: Heap ya compost e bontshwa e le cut open hore bokahare bo bonahale. E bontsha layers tse fapanyetsanang tsa dintho tse ommeng tse sootho le dintho tse foreshe tse tala. Mocheso o nyoloha ho tswa bohareng; motsu o bontsha hore qubu e a phetholwa.
